target: Mean decoder-block-18 activation of the complete answer, including the non-overlapping canonical assistant suffix for stopped answers, matching the saved paper target.

projection.method: two-component PCA of raw answer activations

derivation.ridge: Evaluate the saved ridge checkpoint on the final prompt-token activation: ((x - x_mean) / x_scale) @ weight + y_mean. Apply the saved PCA center and basis.
derivation.mlp: Evaluate the original AttentionProbe class on 32 adaptive-average prompt-activation bins using the saved checkpoint and normalization. The class uses learned-query attention pooling and a two-hidden-layer GELU MLP. Denormalize the answer prediction and apply the saved PCA center and basis.
derivation.gaussianPoints: Select the 64 archived projected samples for each test prompt. The selected Gaussian is low-rank plus diagonal, rank 256, with heteroscedastic context scaling and sample_scale 1.25. Samples equal the MLP prediction plus scaled zero-mean Gaussian noise.
derivation.gaussianMean: The mean field is the analytic conditional mean, equal to the projected MLP prediction. It is not the empirical mean of the 64 displayed Gaussian samples.
derivation.flowPoints: Select the 64 archived projected particles at Euler step 1000. The trajectory field selects steps 0, 50, 200, 500, 800 and 1000 from the same saved trajectory with common initial noise.
derivation.flowMean: The mean field is the arithmetic mean of the 64 archived final projected particles, computed before rounding.
derivation.observations: Retain the four original archived projected answer means and recorded responses for seeds 43–46. For seeds 47–58, select matching answer-mean sidecar rows from the verified 16-rollout bank, cast float32 means to bfloat16 as in the study target assembly, convert back to float32 and apply the unchanged saved PCA center and basis on CPU. Prompt hashes, response hashes, token counts, activation-span records, source-shard manifest hashes and model/decoding configuration are verified.
derivation.coordinateRounding: All point coordinates are rounded to five decimal places for export.
derivation.metadataSelection: Gaussian metadata retains family, rank, sample_scale and scale_mode; validation-score fields are omitted.
derivation.additionalTargetAssemblyReference: studies/seed_prompt_scaling_100k/prepare_targets.py:load_new_seed in the experimental source used to assemble the supplementary bank
derivation.tokenTrajectories: Read the exact saved answer-token activations for the same 96 prompt/seed pairs. Compute cumulative float32 means, cast each mean to bfloat16 as for study targets, and project with the unchanged training-fitted PCA. Decode exact generated IDs to UTF-16 text offsets. Final displayed positions reuse the existing archived answer means, including the canonical assistant suffix.

fieldSemantics.forecasts.gaussian.mean: Projected analytic conditional mean; identical to forecasts.mlp.point
fieldSemantics.forecasts.gaussian.points: 64 projected samples from the conditional Gaussian
fieldSemantics.forecasts.flow.mean: Empirical mean of the 64 final projected flow samples
fieldSemantics.forecasts.flow.trajectory: Saved flow-solver states, not answer-token states
fieldSemantics.observations[].point: Observed complete-answer activation mean in the same PCA plane
fieldSemantics.trajectories.rollouts.points: Per-token projected cumulative answer means, including the canonical assistant suffix at the end.
fieldSemantics.trajectories.rollouts.textEnds: UTF-16 offsets into the original response after each token; the suffix does not extend displayed text.

validation.method: Original PyTorch AttentionProbe CPU inference and the ridge formula were checked against an independently implemented NumPy inference path. The initial six examples compare against five-decimal NumPy exports; the eight added examples compare unrounded projected values. Final deterministic points use the PyTorch outputs. Token endpoints are independently checked for all 224 rollouts.
validation.observedCoordinatePolicy: Archived projected observations are retained; CPU reconstruction is a numerical cross-check.

limitations: Fourteen illustrative, non-sensitive public test prompts selected for varied topics and readable length, with all 16 recorded rollouts from seeds 43–58. They are not a representative benchmark; the two-dimensional projection does not establish full-dimensional accuracy or calibration.

All forecasts and responses are recorded research results. Animation replays saved data; no model inference runs in the browser. The forecasts are conditioned on the complete prompt and remain fixed while observations are revealed.
Uses the saved paper visualization trajectory, integrated with 1,000 Euler steps. Main paper evaluations use 32 steps. Trajectory time is flow integration time, not generated-token time.

The demo adds 12 recorded continuations from the supplementary 16-rollout LMSYS bank to the four primary rollouts. All 16 use the same prompt, model revision, layer, decoding settings and answer-target definition. The forecasts stay fixed. The main paper quantitative tables use four primary rollout targets; this expanded visualization is not a recomputation of those tables.

observationBank.name: LMSYS 16-rollout supplementary bank
observationBank.note: The demo adds 12 recorded continuations from the supplementary 16-rollout LMSYS bank to the four primary rollouts. All 16 use the same prompt, model revision, layer, decoding settings and answer-target definition. The forecasts stay fixed. The main paper quantitative tables use four primary rollout targets; this expanded visualization is not a recomputation of those tables.
observationBank.additionalProjection: The added answer means are rounded to bfloat16, matching the study target assembly, then projected on CPU with the original saved training-set PCA center and basis. The four original projected observations are retained unchanged.

additionalConfigurationChecks.answerSummary: mean over exact generated tokens plus the non-overlapping canonical assistant suffix, matching the issue-779 target

metadata.definition: Cumulative mean of saved decoder-block-18 answer-token activations, rounded to bfloat16 and projected with the original training-fitted PCA.
metadata.answerSuffix: The final frame includes the saved non-overlapping canonical assistant suffix, matching the study target.
metadata.textOffsets: UTF-16 character offsets from decoding the exact generated token IDs; canonical suffix tokens do not add displayed text.
metadata.endpointPolicy: Completed rollouts use the original archived endpoint; independently reconstructed endpoints must agree within 0.002 projected units.

promptExpansion.selection: Selected from the held-out test set for varied subjects and readable prompts before examining forecast accuracy. All 16 recorded rollouts are retained for every example.
